summaries.headline: NHS trusts begin piloting AI triage assistants
summaries.summary: Three NHS trusts are trialling AI triage assistants to prioritise non-urgent appointments, with clinicians retaining final sign-off. Early results suggest shorter waiting lists but mixed staff feedback on workload.
key_facts: Pilot covers three trusts and roughly 120,000 appointments
Clinicians keep final sign-off on every triage decision
Initial waiting-time reduction of 11% in the pilot cohort

summaries.headline: Regulators publish first code of practice for clinical AI
summaries.summary: A new code of practice sets expectations for validation, audit trails, and post-market monitoring of clinical AI tools. Vendors will need documented evidence of safety and bias testing before deployment.
key_facts: Code applies to both providers and third-party vendors
Requires post-market monitoring and incident reporting
Compliance window runs through the next financial year

summaries.headline: Health AI startup Acme raises £40m Series B
summaries.summary: Acme Health AI raised £40m to expand its clinical documentation copilot across NHS trusts and into two European markets. The company says the round will fund integrations and a larger clinical safety team.
key_facts: £40m Series B led by a European growth fund
Expansion into two European markets planned
Headcount to grow 60% over the next year
